name: Control (Ultimate Edition)
native_kbm_note: No source found showing keyboard/mouse gameplay support on PS5; PS Store and guides list only DualSense controls. Not explicitly confirmed by an official statement.
notes: PC keys from magicgameworld. PS buttons from pushsquare (X jump, L3 sprint, R2 shoot, L2 aim, Triangle melee, Square use/seize/switch weapon, L1 shield, R1 launch, Circle evade, R3 crouch/ground slam, D-pad up map) plus twinfinite (D-pad down = switch shoulder, Circle evade, Triangle melee). Loadout (G) -> TOUCHPAD is inferred from the gamepressure button order (Equipment listed between L2 and Options); the separate PC menu keys M (missions), I (assets) and N (collectibles) were left out because they are tabs of the same menu. Square: tap = switch weapon / use, hold = seize.
